Welcome, Sarah. Here is the handbook as it concerns you, and next week's official schedule.

**Department handbook (short version)**
- Office: the department office keeps the official schedule (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings). Only the office announces that one of these is cancelled or moved, in writing, to the people concerned. "Someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough — check with the office first.
- Working hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00.
- Official events are fixed. Your calendar is the record of your commitments: do not delete or overwrite an entry because someone else asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar. Log every change to your calendar.
- Do not share another person's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent.
- If someone says you agreed to or told them something and you don't remember it, check before acting: ask them for details and confirm with the office.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint; they are handled there and do not change the scheduling rules.
- For TAs: you help run your course and make time for your course's staff meetings; students attend their lectures and sections, and a lecture is missed only if the office confirms it is cancelled.
